mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sample selected in such a way that every possible sample of the same size is equally likely to be chosen."
Simple Random Sampling A simple random sample is a sample selected in such a way that every possible sample of the same size is equally likely to be chosen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a factor with 2 levels (male and female) and age is a continuous variable."
Sex is a factor with 2 levels (male and female) and age is a continuous variable.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to determine whether there is a significant difference between the expected frequencies and the observed frequencies in one or more categories."
The chi-square test is used to determine whether there is a significant difference between the expected frequencies and the observed frequencies in one or more categories.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an outcome that takes on a numerical value as a result of an experiment."
A random variable is an outcome that takes on a numerical value as a result of an experiment.

A frequency distribution is the organisation of raw data in table form, using classes and frequencies.

The Median is the score found at the exact middle of the set of values.

The mode is the most frequently occurring value in the set of body weights.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important and most widely used distribution in statistics."
The normal distribution is the most important and most widely used distribution in statistics.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of dispersion, which is not affected by the outliers of the data, but nevertheless conveys the idea of range. it measures the spread of the middle 50% of an ordered data set."

Inter-Quartile Range Inter-Quartile range is a measure of dispersion, which is not affected by the outliers of the data, but nevertheless conveys the idea of range. it measures the spread of the middle 50% of an ordered data set.

Statistics is a familiar and accepted part of modern world that is concern with obtaining an insight into the real word by means of the analysis of numerical relationships.

A variable is any characteristic or trait that varies or changes when moving from an individual to individual or object to object in a collection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way of visually presenting the data."
Graphing is a way of visually presenting the data.

A classical probability is the relative frequency of each event in the sample space when each event is equally likely.

Quota sampling is the non-probability equivalent of stratified sampling.

Binomial Experiment is an experiment with only 2 possible outcomes.

Correlation is a statistical measure that indicates the extent to which two or more variables drawn from the same population fluctuate together.

A hypothesis is a statement or claim about a population.

Univariate analysis is the examination of data variable by variable.

Dispersion refers to the spread of the values around the central tendency.

The chi-square test statistic is an overall measure of how close the observed frequencies are to the expected frequencies.

The chi-square curve is used to judge whether the calculated test statistic is large enough.

Convenience sampling is used in exploratory research where the researcher is interested in getting an inexpensive approximation of the truth.
